evidence.ac_rerun_note: All 5 verification commands were re-run fresh from the worktree root (git-bash) after the final code state was committed; each printed exactly one PASS AC-n: line and exited 0. The suite floor moved 340 -> 344 passed (4 new tests in backend/tests/test_sqlite_contention_t19.py), exactly 2 xfailed, 0 failed; ruff check . is clean.
warnings: AC-3 was satisfied via the WAL arm (the issue allows WAL or the documented single-writer constraint): PRAGMA journal_mode=wal is enabled in a SQLAlchemy connect event listener in backend/app/database.py. The pragma is best-effort (sqlite3.Error suppressed at connect time) deliberately: raising from the connect event would, in this SQLAlchemy build, leak the DBAPI connection the pool never closes after a failed connect event, and on Windows the open handle keeps the file locked past the connection's death, which corrupts the test_log_hygiene.py restore and cascades suite failures. A non-database file still fails at the first statement with the same driver error through the normal 500 path, exactly as before WAL existed.

AC-4: the write-on-GET path (_sweep_expired in the staff-list read) was made contention-safe rather than moved: the sweep's commit is wrapped so that the SQLite busy/locked failure raises the typed 503 AppError STORE_BUSY (same contract outcome as the HTTP write paths) after rolling the session back, never the raw OperationalError. The sweep stays request-driven on the staff-list read; after the lock clears the next read persists the transition. The read path is probed at the service level (list_waitlist) per the definer's warning: the HTTP staff GET under a held lock answers 401 via the auth verifier's own database read (adjacent B-4 symptom, out of scope - the auth layer is not in the Files list).

The legacy literal 30s busy timeout in backend/app/database.py connect_args is replaced by the named constant SQLITE_BUSY_TIMEOUT = 5.0, documented at the binding site (0.5..10s window the issue names as reasonable); app/errors.py imports the same constant to size the Retry-After header it advertises on the 503 STORE_BUSY.

The 503 STORE_BUSY row was added to the _docs/specs.md section 11 error table (the ERROR_CODES loader picks it up); the openapi-side entry is logged under Inconsistencies deferred, the same deferral as INTERNAL_ERROR / NOT_FOUND / METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED (owned by platform issue #3).
The X-Request-ID correlation half of the audit item is out of scope here (owned by t26 / platform issue #81), per the definer handoff.

No existing test was modified or weakened: backend/tests/test_sqlite_contention_t19.py is a new additive file whose four tests mirror the AC-1..AC-4 probes one-for-one (subprocess probes against scratch databases) plus the AC-2 static arm in-process. The worktree's docs/issues/t19.md is a 27-line stub; the authoritative groomed issue (with the verification commands) was read from the main repo's uncommitted copy, which the definer synced to platform issue #74.
